content.text:
TASK:
Sign in to MockCore Teller. Look up member 12345 and read the current balance of their REGULAR SAVINGS account from the member's accounts table into an output named 'savingsBalance'. After reading the balance, probe one exceptional state: search for member number 99999 (which does not exist) and declare the not-found behavior as business outcome MEMBER_NOT_FOUND with a marker you can see on screen. Then declare_done with capability_id 'member.readSavingsBalance'.

PARAMETERS:
- memberId (internal): Caller-supplied parameter 'memberId'. — value: "12345"
- operatorId (internal): Resolved from the environment (MOCK_CU_USER) at invocation time; never stored in the artifact. — value: "teller1"
- operatorPassword (secret): Resolved from the environment (MOCK_CU_PASS) at invocation time; never stored in the artifact. — value: (secret — reference with param, never typed literally)

The application is served at http://localhost:4173. The browser is currently blank — begin by navigating to the application.

input.intent: Open the MockCore Teller application to begin sign-in.

input.description: When searching for a member number that does not exist (e.g. 99999), the Member Search returns no result rows and displays a message indicating no match. This is the not-found state.

input.title: Read Member REGULAR SAVINGS Balance
input.description: Signs into MockCore Teller with the operator credentials, searches for a member by number (memberId), opens the member detail page, and reads the REGULAR SAVINGS (suffix S00) account balance from the accounts table into output 'savingsBalance'. Requires memberId plus operator credentials. Returns savingsBalance (e.g. "$4,821.97"). Exceptional outcome MEMBER_NOT_FOUND occurs when the member number does not exist, shown by the message "No members matched your search."
